source_caption_text:
Still one of the funniest interviews ever 😂😭😭

Some interviews are funny because the people involved are clearly trying to be funny. This wasn’t one of them. DJ Khaled and Rick Ross sat down for GQ’s snack debate, and somehow a simple conversation about food turned into one of the funniest moments either of them has ever had on camera.

The moment it went completely off the rails was when Khaled started talking about almond milk. Ross immediately questioned the logic behind it, leading to the unforgettable “Where is the almond milk? Show me the almond nipple” moment. Khaled trying to seriously defend almond milk while Ross kept questioning how you could milk an almond made the whole exchange even funnier.

The clip quickly became a meme, with “almond nipple” becoming one of those lines people kept bringing back online. It’s the perfect example of why Khaled and Ross work so well together on camera. Neither of them needed to force the joke, they just had a completely ridiculous conversation and somehow created an internet classic.

Via @gq
